text:
rachael: Quick proposal — lightweight fast-followup template for postmortems. Aim: reduce open remediation time and surface recurring patterns faster. sketch below, open to edits.

rachael: Timeline template (example):
```
T+0 (incident): initial note in #incident-xxx, brief triage, impact tag, IC assigned
T+24h: triage summary + immediate mitigations logged
T+72h: owner(s) for each remediation + target ETA (pilot: 2 weeks)
T+14d: remediation sprint end; roll-forward or rollback decision
T+30d: recurrence check / metric regressions review
T+90d: long-term RCA closure & lessons learned digest
```

rachael: Comms cadence idea: daily 09:30 status in channel while active, 48h stakeholder email digest, public customer note for P1s within 72h if needed.

alexc: +1 on the timeline. Can we add an SLO/impact tag line (e.g., user-facing latency, errors, data-loss) in the T+0 stub so triage knows priority? :thumbsup:

rachael: yep — add a required "Impact tags" field at T+0. I'll update the snippet.

priya: ops-bot can post reminders: create a ticket in #incidents with checklist items at T+24 and T+72. Would reduce human forgetfulness.

ops-bot: scheduled_reminder created -> "T+24 triage reminder" for thread 2245678901.

jamal: I can pilot this for the next P1. Volunteer to own the 2-week remediation sprint and report back on practical cadence.

alexc: for IC rotation, proposing 2-week IC blocks with a designated backup. Hand-off template: one-line incident summary, top 3 mitigations in-flight, pending owner list. Short checklist.

rachael: agree. also suggest a monthly quick retro (15m) across recent incidents to find recurring patterns. Keep it lightweight.

priya: will wire ops-bot to create the monthly retro calendar invite if we tag threads with "recurrence-check".

jamal: assigning owners now for pilot:
- infra: jamal (ETA T+14d)
- runtime: alexc (ETA T+10d)
- monitoring: priya (ETA T+7d)

rachael: great — can each of you drop a one-line acceptance reply here so I can close the loop?

alexc: accepted. will add SLO impact tag in initial triage template and update runbook.

priya: accepted. ops-bot reminder + calendar invite plumbing in progress.

jamal: accepted. I'll run the remediation sprint and post daily stand notes in-thread.

rachael: thanks all. next step: I'll push updated snippet to the incident playbook and tag this as a runbook change. ops-bot, please close the T+24 reminder once the triage summary is posted.

ops-bot: reminder closed -> "T+24 triage reminder" for thread 2245678901.

rachael: follow-up owner: rachael. target to ship playbook changes by 2245680500 (EOD tomorrow).

jamal: noted. I'll post the sprint kickoff message at 2245678950.
